preamble: ESTATE DUTY (ABOLITION) ACT NO. 10 OF 1982 Published in Kenya Gazette Vol. LXXXIV—No. 27 on 28 June 1982 Assented to on 25 June 1982 Commenced on 28 June 1982 An Act of Parliament to abolish the imposition of estate duty

1.title: Short title and construction
1.text: This Act may be cited as the Estate Duty (Abolition) Act, 1982, and shall be read as one with the Estate Duty Act (Cap. 483).

2.title: Abolition of estate duty
2.text: Nothwithstanding the provisions of the Estate Duty Act (Cap. 483), no estate duty shall be levied or paid on property which passes on the death of any person dying on or after 1st January, 1982.
